name: @nanoempire/astryx-proof-native-pack
purpose: Agent-discoverable, constraint-governed UI component pack for the Deterministic Verification Layer (SkillProof + BidShield + RecallRadar + x402 Settlement). Prevents coding agents from inventing unverified raw-div compliance UIs.

deterministic_stack_position.layer_1_identity: ERC-8004 / A2A Agent Card (/.well-known/agent-card.json) — proves WHO is calling
deterministic_stack_position.layer_2_deterministic_verification: SkillProof (/api/skillproof/status) + BidShield (/api/bidshield/gate) — proves MAY THEY PROCEED with reproducible, non-LLM rule & AST outputs
deterministic_stack_position.layer_3_settlement: x402 v2 / AP4M / AP2 / Stripe — moves money under verified bounds

components.name: TrustManifestCard
components.description: Displays an offline-verifiable SkillProof Ed25519 Trust Manifest pinned to a Git commit_tree_sha and canonicalized via RFC 8785 (JCS).

components.name: SettlementReceipt
components.description: Displays a verifiable x402 Base USDC, AP4M voucher, or Stripe settlement receipt with strict ledger honesty (operator_self_test vs production_settled).

components.name: ComplianceMatrix
components.description: Displays a deterministic BidShield solicitation gate decision, AP2 Human-Not-Present mandate recommendation, quantified Decision Exposure (JEV), and triggered deontic clauses.

components.name: RecallDeltaTable
components.description: Displays a normalized RecallRadar match schedule across 46,642 CPSC, FDA, and Health Canada safety enforcement records.
